title: Kody Technolab Limited (NSE: KODYTECH) — Business, Valuation and Portfolio Action
sector: Technology — Commercial robotics, autonomous mobile systems, and enterprise software
archetype: High-growth SME robotics assembler with extreme working-capital absorption and negative cash flow
entry_posture: NO_NEW_ALLOCATION; REJECTED because the stock trades at 129x P/E with deeply negative free cash flow (-₹53 Cr in FY26) and 192 debtor days; base-case fair value is below current support.
verdict_rule_summary: Reject new capital when valuation embeds an unsustainable 38%+ 10-year growth hurdle, free cash flow is negative, and working capital is stretched past 190 days.
holding_rationale: Kody Technolab is not held in the consolidated portfolio; action is deferred to watchlist monitoring.

holding_alerts.instruction: Do not commit fresh capital at CMP ₹1,560.00 (129x P/E). Express any interest strictly via cash equity after audited debtor normalization.
Re-underwrite audited debtor collection days, operating cash flow, and valuation compression before considering entry.

destinations.entry_condition: Re-underwrite after next quarterly filings; require fresh support band and target producing at least 1.5:1 asymmetry.

destinations.recommendation: Retain reviewed capital in cash/liquid treasury until a qualified candidate clears both evidence and entry gates.
destinations.rationale: KODYTECH is rejected for new capital due to 129x P/E and negative FCF; shortlist candidates are extended or fail asymmetry hurdles.
destinations.entry_condition: Reassess after audited debtor normalization or when a fresh shortlist setup clears both business quality and entry gates.

primer: Kody Technolab is an Ahmedabad-based commercial robotics and software company that pivoted from IT consulting into autonomous service robots. While trailing revenue reached ₹111 crore, the business exhibits severe working capital absorption with debtor days at 192 days and negative free cash flow of negative ₹53 crore in FY26. At current market price of ₹1,560.00, the stock trades at 129 times earnings and 9.8 times book value, embedding an unrealistic 38% ten-year earnings growth hurdle. New capital is REJECTED, current holding action is NOT_HELD, and reviewed capital is 100% retained in Cash.
sizing_table_takeaway: REJECTED verdict means zero new risk-unit allocation. The ₹1,410.13–₹1,491.42 support band and ₹1,337.57 stop level are analytical monitoring references only, not live orders.
